description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a critical leadership opportunity to oversee all nursing operations, ensure the highest standards of patient care, and contribute to a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a visionary leader who can inspire excellence and drive continuous improvement.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for managing nursing staff, developing care plans, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a culture of compassion and quality. This vital role is seeking to be filled quickly, offering a competitive salary for a dedicated professional ready to make a significant impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a DON or ADON
Experience within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing nursing team
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time Director of Nursing position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
